About the East Bay Bike Party group ride

A themed monthly ride across Oakland, Berkeley and the rest of the East Bay, usually starting at a BART station. Self-supported: bring lights, lock, layers and snacks. Six rules, including stop at lights and stay to the right. Instagram has the most current ride info.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
